answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable bond that becomes its anchor: the stake unlocks only after 30 days of peer-verified useful work. A sybil farm spinning up a thousand hollow identities must lock a thousand bonds, and any account caught colluding forfeits its stake. Reputation also decays unless renewed, so no cheap fake can ride an early zenith of trust forever; the attacker's cost scales linearly with every fake.
